services.title: What Fursa does
services.later: Not available yet: CV upload and tailoring, cover letters, search and filters, statistics.

feed.name: Feed
feed.text: Jobs from several sources, each scored against your profile and shown best first. You can filter by status and load more.

why.name: Why it matches
why.text: Each job shows the skills you have and the ones you lack, with a short note written by AI in your language.

alerts.name: Alerts
alerts.text: Get alerts daily or instantly, only above the minimum score you set.

pipeline.name: Pipeline
pipeline.text: Follow each job from saved to applied, interview or rejected.

promise.title: What Fursa does not do
promise.text: You read why a job matches, open the posting, and apply yourself.

data.title: Your data
data.text: You can export your data or delete your account at any time.
data.note: Deleting your account cannot be undone.

how.a: You tell Fursa the roles, skills, places and level you want. It collects jobs from several sources, scores each one against your profile and shows you the best first, with the reason.

sources.q: Where do the jobs come from?
sources.a: Fursa collects them from several sources. Each job links to the original posting, where you apply.

alerts.a: You can turn on alerts on Telegram or by email, daily or instantly. You choose the minimum score and the hour of the daily digest.

apply.a: No. Fursa never applies for you. You read why a job matches, open the posting and apply yourself.

data.a: You can export all your data, or delete your account, at any time. Deleting cannot be undone.

languages.a: Arabic, French and English. The interface and the short note on each job follow the language you choose.

closing.title: Start with what you look for.
closing.text: Create an account, then add your roles, skills, places and level.
